senses.gloss:
mṛgá, m.
 —1. (like AS. deōr) wild animal,
beast of the forest, as opp. to paśu,
‘cattle,’ 67^2; then
 —2. (w. the same specialization
of mg as in Eng. deer) animal
of the genus Cervus, deer, gazelle. [perhaps
‘the ranger, rover,’ √mṛj, q. v.: for
2, observe the use of deer in the more
general sense in King Lear, iii. 4. 128,
“rats and such small deer.”]
